best seller,Placed order for item , and they arrived super quick the next day , well packed and as described . Thank you very much ! I highly recommend this Ebayer , excellent service all round ! Cheers 👍🏻👍🏻

La motherboard é arrivata nella sua scatola originale con tutti gli accessori. Sembra in perfetto stato e appena assemblato il PC provvederò a testarla. La transazione è stata perfetta e le tempistiche della spedizione molto rapide. Segnalo inoltre che l'imballaggio esterno era semplicemente eccezionale, letteralmente "a prova di bomba". Da ex spedizioniere posso affermare di aver visto raramente qualità e accuratezza simili. Venditore consigliatissimo!!
Received goods in a timely manner, well packaged for transit, good communication, exactly as described, good quality and value for money. Recommended seller. Thank you.

Great ebayer, communicated when it was posted, packaged it well and delivered promptly. Item was fully functional and as described. FedEx processing fee was a little high, so if I used them again, I would arrange  a different courier. Would use again/recommend.
Ordered item and it turned up a couple of weeks later - as advertised. It was well packed with 3 layers of bubble wrapped enveloped and inside a plastic case with foam padding. Duty was also paid.

Super bien emballé : Double boite carton + papier bulle à chaque fois.
Un heatsink + thermal pad pour nvme de fourni, penser à en avoir un second sous la main.
Comme annoncé, c'est une carte d'occasion, des traces d'usures sont visibles. 
Cependant, de la pate thermique était déposée sur le socket, ce qui aurait pu être nettoyé avant envoi.
